claim_ceiling: This file is a metric and metrology catalogue. It contains no site measurement, environmental baseline, permit limit, sensor reading, ecological result or site clearance.

primary_standard.title: Guidelines on multi-dimensional environmental metrics and management for data centres

official_metrics.name: Power usage effectiveness
official_metrics.definition: Annual total data-centre energy divided by annual IT equipment energy over the same continuous 12-month period; use dPUE/iPUE/mPUE labels where appropriate.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Compare equivalent meter boundary, period and measurement category. A design target is not an operational annual measurement.

official_metrics.name: Energy reuse factor
official_metrics.definition: Energy reused by another party divided by total data-centre energy; measure thermal energy at the logical handoff boundary.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Credit only metered energy delivered and accepted at the handoff; do not credit theoretical heat-reuse potential.

official_metrics.name: Space usage effectiveness
official_metrics.definition: IT equipment area divided by total data-centre area.
official_metrics.standard_reference: Green Grid definition cited by ITU-T L.1312
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Use the same definition of facility and IT equipment area.

official_metrics.name: Water usage effectiveness
official_metrics.definition: Data-centre water consumption divided by IT equipment energy; report the selected ISO/IEC 30134-9 WUE category.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: State WUE category 1/2/3 and compare only identical categories and periods. Report seawater intake and return/discharge separately; WUE alone does not characterise marine intake/outfall effects.

official_metrics.name: Proportion of reclaimed and other non-potable water
official_metrics.definition: Consumption of reclaimed/non-potable water divided by total data-centre water withdrawal.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: The recommendation's total-water-withdrawal denominator excludes seawater. Report seawater intake and discharge separately; do not use this metric to imply that seawater intake is negligible.

official_metrics.name: Reuse and recycling rate
official_metrics.definition: Reused or recycled waste electrical and electronic equipment divided by total WEEE generated in the evaluation period.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Declare whether numerator and denominator use count, mass or volume; mass is preferred for lifecycle material accounting.

official_metrics.name: Renewable energy factor
official_metrics.definition: Renewable energy owned and controlled by the data centre divided by total data-centre energy consumption.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Keep REF separate from hourly carbon-free matching and contractual certificates; declare time matching and ownership/control.

official_metrics.name: Carbon usage effectiveness
official_metrics.definition: Annual data-centre CO2e emissions divided by IT equipment energy demand.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: State scopes, emissions factors, time resolution and treatment of purchased electricity and backup fuel.

official_metrics.name: Greenhouse gas emission factor
official_metrics.definition: GHG emissions associated with the relevant energy consumption divided by the energy quantity under the declared boundary.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: State grid/contract/generation factors, location and temporal granularity; do not conflate average and marginal factors.

official_metrics.name: Air pollutant mass concentration
official_metrics.definition: Mass of a measured air pollutant component per gas volume.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: List pollutant species, sampling method, location, averaging period and detection limit.

official_metrics.name: Water pollutant mass concentration
official_metrics.definition: Mass of a measured pollutant component per sample volume.
official_metrics.standard_reference: ITU-T L.1312 section 6.5; ISO 18191 method reference
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Use paired upstream/reference and discharge samples, flow context, species/analyte list, uncertainty and detection limits.

official_metrics.name: Land pollution mass concentration
official_metrics.definition: Mass of a measured land pollutant per dry mass of soil.
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Declare analytes, soil depth, dry-matter basis, sampling method and background reference.

official_metrics.name: Outdoor noise
official_metrics.definition: Equivalent continuous A-weighted sound pressure level measured at the digital infrastructure emitter/property boundary.
official_metrics.standard_reference: ITU-T L.1312 section 6.5; ITU-T L.1510 cited
official_metrics.comparison_rule: State day/night window, averaging period, background noise and applicable land-use/receptor context. Underwater radiated noise is a separate marine extension.

official_metrics.name: Mean species abundance
official_metrics.definition: Mean abundance of original species relative to an undisturbed baseline; ITU-T describes baseline abundance before construction and post-construction abundance over a defined area.
official_metrics.standard_reference: ITU-T L.1312 section 6.5; GLOBIO method cited
official_metrics.comparison_rule: Use independently designed ecological baseline and reference/control stations; disclose taxa, season, sampling effort, spatial support and uncertainty. Do not treat one MSA score as complete proof of no harm.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Seawater intake flow and cumulative volume
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Quantify withdrawal/recirculation at each intake and distinguish single-pass from recirculating cooling.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Seawater return flow and cumulative volume
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Quantify discharge and enable a mass/heat balance; report bypass, purge and cleaning discharges separately.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Intake-to-return temperature difference
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Quantify thermal alteration at the outfall and support heat-load calculation.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Spatial and temporal thermal-plume exposure
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Characterise the spatial and temporal footprint of the thermal anomaly, including plume extent, duration and receptor exposure; do not infer impact from the outfall thermometer alone.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Net thermal energy discharged or reused
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Calculate mass-flow-weighted thermal energy using calibrated flow and paired temperatures; separately report accepted external reuse.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Seasonal seawater temperature and salinity profile
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Characterise depth-resolved thermal resource and seasonal variability rather than assuming cold ocean conditions.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Current, wave and mixing state
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Describe dilution, dispersion, intake recirculation, structural loading and marine access constraints.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Marine water chemistry and dissolved oxygen
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Detect chemical changes associated with cooling, corrosion products, cleaning, biocide or discharge.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Discharge pollutant mass flux
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Prevent dilution from masking total pollutant release by combining analyte-specific concentration with synchronized discharge flow; report concentration and mass load together.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Seabed sediment and contaminant condition
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Detect deposition, scour, resuspension and land/sea-floor pollutants over construction, operation and maintenance.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Underwater radiated noise
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Characterise construction, pumps, cooling, vessels and maintenance noise; do not substitute outdoor dB(A).

marine_extension_metrics.name: Benthic habitat and taxon abundance
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Provide ecology-specific evidence alongside MSA, including benthic assemblages and sensitive habitats.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Biofouling and invasive species observations
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Track cooling-loop and intake structures as ecological vectors and explain thermal performance drift.

marine_extension_metrics.name: Entrainment and impingement observation
marine_extension_metrics.purpose: Characterise organism interactions with screens and intakes; use non-invasive observation and approved methods.

sensor_package.cadence: interval_metering with synchronized raw interval data

sensor_package.placement: paired sensors at heat exchanger boundaries and intake/outfall
sensor_package.cadence: continuous synchronized telemetry; retain raw intervals

sensor_package.placement: intake/outfall depths plus independent reference stations and depth profiles
sensor_package.cadence: continuous or repeat campaigns sufficient to cover seasonal and event variability

sensor_package.placement: paired intake, outfall, plume and reference/control stations
sensor_package.cadence: continuous in-situ variables plus laboratory sampling at regulator/ecologist-approved interval

sensor_package.placement: predeclared impact zone and independent reference/control stations
sensor_package.cadence: baseline before works and repeated seasonal surveys through construction, operation, maintenance and decommission

sensor_package.placement: source and receptor hydrophone locations at surveyed ranges/depths
sensor_package.cadence: construction and operating modes, including vessel/maintenance events

sensor_package.placement: co-located metocean reference appropriate to candidate site
sensor_package.cadence: continuous through representative seasonal and storm windows

site_evidence_record_contract.rule: unknown, provisional, unavailable, synthetic, stale, uncalibrated, clock-skewed or conflicting evidence cannot be presented as measured zero or used to satisfy an environmental gate; every sample's signed clock offset and calibration-validity window must be checked against its own observation window.
site_evidence_record_contract.time_rule: Store UTC timestamps and signed per-sample logger/sensor clock offset plus synchronization evidence; the maximum offset is a project acceptance parameter, not a universal standard limit; do not silently interpolate gaps across environmental events.
site_evidence_record_contract.uncertainty_rule: Report the uncertainty budget, detection limit, sensor calibration independence domain, laboratory-batch independence domain and common batch uncertainty with every numeric result; common hydraulic residence-time and common laboratory-batch errors must be propagated as shared inputs; an outfall below detection limit is not proof that no pollutant exists.

spatial_sampling_design.rule: Station positions and depths are set by independent hydrography/ecology and the applicable consent; do not invent a fixed plume radius or station spacing before site survey.
spatial_sampling_design.seasonal_rule: Baseline and follow-up sampling must represent material seasonal conditions and relevant event windows; a single survey is not a lifecycle baseline.

aggregation_policy.optional_itu_comprehensive_metric: May be reported as supplementary per ITU-T L.1312 with published normalization, best/worst values and weights.
aggregation_policy.project_rule: Publish raw metric values, dimensions, uncertainty and life-cycle stage. Never let a composite score offset protected-habitat exclusion, legal noncompliance, unknown baseline, unsafe discharge or a failed ecological hard gate.
aggregation_policy.environmental_claim_ceiling: No claim of zero ecological harm can be inferred from PUE, WUE, REF, CUE or a single MSA result.

goos_eov_alignment.framework: Global Ocean Observing System Essential Ocean Variables
goos_eov_alignment.principle: Use the current GOOS EOV specification sheets and best-practice guidance as the interoperable ocean-variable layer. GOOS notes that EOV specification sheets are under revision; pin the accessed version and do not freeze a custom project taxonomy as an official EOV list.
goos_eov_alignment.adoption_rule: Map only the EOVs materially relevant to the approved site question. Preserve official EOV identity and current specification version. Project-specific outfall, intake, pollutant flux and thermal-plume metrics remain project extensions, not newly declared GOOS EOVs.

biodiversity_data_interoperability.framework: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS) and Darwin Core
biodiversity_data_interoperability.purpose: Preserve interoperable biodiversity occurrence, event, measurement/fact and, where relevant, DNA-derived records with traceable source, location, date, depth, taxon, method, ownership and QC flags.
biodiversity_data_interoperability.project_rule: Candidate terms are a mapping starting point, not a complete Darwin Core profile. Confirm current OBIS Manual guidance and provider/node requirements before publication. Preserve source-specific fields and quality flags; failed checks are flagged/quarantined rather than silently deleted or upgraded.
biodiversity_data_interoperability.rights_rule: Use rights-reviewed and purpose-compatible records. Retain attribution, ownership, licence, sensitive-species location restrictions and applicable CARE/FAIR obligations.

measurement_pipeline.claim_ceiling: The measurement bundle and verifier are a software/metrology fixture. No field observation, compliance, ecological result or site clearance is asserted.
